title: A subset of the first 2018 positive integers

## A subset of the first 2018 positive integers

### Problem
Let $S$ be the set of integers from 1 to 2018. A certain subset $B$ of $S$ has 1025 elements. Prove that there are two elements of $B$ which differ by 31.

### Solution (adapted from the official solution)
Suppose for contradiction that no two elements of $B$ differ by 31.

Define the shifted set $C = B + 31 = \{b + 31 : b \in B\}$.
Since $|B| = 1025$, $|C| = 1025$.

By our assumption, no element $b + 31$ can be in $B$, so $B \cap C = \emptyset$.

Since $B \subseteq S = \{1, 2, \dots, 2018\}$, every element of $C$ is a positive integer $\ge 32$.
The only elements of $C$ that could lie outside of $S$ are those with $b + 31 > 2018$, which means $b \in \{1988, 1989, \dots, 2018\}$.
There are at most 31 such integers in $S$.

Therefore at most 31 elements of $C$ are greater than 2018, so at least $1025 - 31 = 994$ elements of $C$ must lie inside $S$.

Since $B \cap C = \emptyset$, all these elements of $C \cap S$ must belong to the complement $S \setminus B$.

Therefore:

$$|S| \ge |B| + |C \cap S| \ge 1025 + 994 = 2019.$$

However, $|S| = 2018$, which contradicts $|S| \ge 2019$.

Hence $B$ must contain two elements that differ by 31.

### Conceptual Explanation
Shifting $B$ by 31 creates a set $C = B + 31$ disjoint from $B$. At most 31 elements of $C$ exceed 2018, so at least $1025 - 31 = 994$ elements of $C$ reside in $S \setminus B$. Then $|S| \ge |B| + |C \cap S| \ge 1025 + 994 = 2019 > 2018$, a contradiction.

### Key Technique
Shifted set technique $C = B + d$ combined with Pigeonhole / complement bounding.
